definition: The primary account identifier used to reconcile counterparty settlement exposure across the daily snapshot and the downstream regulatory reporting extract that consumes it
Gross notional settlement exposure amount expressed in the reporting currency of the booking entity before any netting collateral or guarantee mitigation is applied to the position
The as-of effective business date on which the regulatory reporting snapshot was taken which is the point-in-time anchor every windowed calculation on this table must be computed at
Net settlement exposure amount after collateral and guarantee mitigation expressed in the reporting currency of the booking entity for the same as-of effective business date
